en.html:
Does not bother her, she says. Here and there her cheeks and hair have gone white. Her features are well formed, which makes the sand stand out all the more.

She is a young woman. A little more attention to appearance would be advisable, I think. But everybody has their own way of thinking. Why should my opinion become compulsory for somebody else?

—Even so, mujhe khatak raha hai. It bothers me.

A stranger, I could leave alone. For now, at least, this girl is my subordinate. Under my protection. Put it that way, and suddenly 'let her do as she pleases' is not such an easy principle.

...Unnecessary interference, most likely. Half on impulse, my fingers are already reaching out.

en.html:
Seeing no change in the racing situation, I get up. A small call of nature. Not urgent, but it has put in its request.

I head for the service area beside the circuit. Captain Ootori comes with me; apparently she wants to wash the sand from her hair. Long, glossy hair. Maintenance difficulties in proportion.

Armour racing attracts a great deal of money and serves as a meeting place for ladies and gentlemen. So facilities exist even for such luxurious necessities. The captain takes a hotel room.

After finishing my business, I go there. Merely looking at the door, I cannot even estimate the cost of one night.

On a policeman's income, stay here once and spend twenty-nine nights of the month outdoors. That much I can understand. Beyond that, my arithmetic is refusing duty.

And she has taken this room to wash her hair. Hair only. The captain's financial way of thinking is a frightening thing to imagine.

ja.html:
状況の膠着を見て取って、席を立つ。
　小用のためだ。若干の尿意を覚えていた。


　サーキットコースに隣接したサービス区画へ向かう。
　大鳥大尉が同行した。髪に砂が絡んだので洗い流し
たいらしい。長く艶のある髪だが、それだけに不便も
多いようだ。

　多大な金が投入される装甲競技は紳士淑女の社交場
という側面も持つため、そうした贅沢といえば贅沢な
需要にも応えられるだけの施設を有する。
　大尉はホテルの一室を借用した。

　用便を済ませた後、その部屋へ向かう。
　……扉を見ただけで、一晩借りるための費用が推量
され<ruby>ない<rt>・・</rt></ruby>ような部屋だった。

　警官の収入でここを宿に選ぶなら、月のうち二九日
は野宿する必要があろう。そこが理解の限度だった。
　髪を洗う為だけにこんな部屋を借りてしまう大尉の
経済感覚は、想像するになかなか恐ろしいものがある。

en.html:
Kanae"............"
Sayo"Please proceed, madam."
Kanae"P-proceed with what?"
Sayo"Hohoho. Such momentum you had. Please continue the lesson."
Kanae"............"
Sayo"Dear me. The instructor's words have gone first?"
Sayo"My mistress cannot possibly be all talk. ...Mr. Minato, you understand the position?"
Kageaki"Yes. More or less."
Sayo"Had the conversation followed madam's own plan, she could have confused you, laughed, and carried on without difficulty."
Sayo"But put her on the defensive, and alas. All attack. Defence has gone home."
Kanae"NANNY!"
Sayo"Ho-ho-ho."
Kageaki"..."
Kanae"U-um, Mr. Kageaki. How shall I explain? The atmosphere here is not appropriate for a proper conversational flourish. The necessary fifth element, 'spirit,' is below the required level—"
Kanae"So... matlab..."
Sayo"A retreat. At full speed, madam."
Kanae"N-NOT retreating! Achha, fine! One moment, please!"
Kanae"I-it is fine. Koi baat nahin. Nothing difficult. Nothing difficult."
Kanae"Breathe in, breathe out. In, out... N-now, then..."
Kageaki"Pardon me."
Kanae"—Yes?"
Kageaki"The joke has gone too far from my side. I will wait outside. Please finish getting ready."
Sayo"Yes. We shall finish shortly."
Kageaki"Take your time, please. Excuse me."
